provenance: Reviewed native-only ledger provenance migration. Expected text authored from the declared policy, not captured from native runtime. Historical Python ledger and all geometry/count fixtures remain immutable.

assumption_rows.name: via_ordinary_cost
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME via_ordinary_cost              = 2.2           mm         [policy] quantization_policy.kViaOrdinaryMm — compiled ordinary-net estimator cost; actual ordinary_via_mm override takes precedence

assumption_rows.name: via_impedance_cost
assumption_rows.text: ASSUME via_impedance_cost             = 7.6           mm         [policy] quantization_policy.kViaImpedanceMm — compiled impedance-net estimator cost; no physical operand reconstruction

calculation_rows.name: est_via_ordinary
calculation_rows.text: CALC   est_via_ordinary               = 2.2           mm         <- via_cost=2.2  ::  resolved ordinary estimator cost (caller override when supplied)

calculation_rows.name: est_via_impedance
